cohort: The same six complete 100-frame public clips as HOCT and ultrack; reused development data.
observations: Frozen native Cellpose instance centroids, using the verified HOCT input bank. No baseline edges or native-tracker features.

organoid.inputs: Released patch extraction, 1/99% intensity normalization, nearest-neighbor resize, asymmetric CoordConv and Platt calibration.
organoid.candidates: Upstream nearest_neighbor(tolerance=2): union of up to five closest forward/backward positions within twice the closest distance; no label-derived gate.
organoid.decoder: Released dpct graph costs/pruning; exact binary flow optimization with SciPy/HiGHS because dpct is absent. Appearance/disappearance probability floor 0.01, boundary buffer 8 micrometers, only_top=True; seeded upstream jitter. All weights one, ignore penalty 2. No organoid-specific postprocessing or depth cutoff.

cellect.inputs: Released two-frame U-Net with native YXZ order and log1p positive-minimum floor plus 1900; no resampling. Sample learned embedding, size and division channels at rounded Cellpose centers. Use the most interior available original tile, removing duplicate identical tile calls.
cellect.candidates: Five nearest next-frame cells in XY-pixel-equivalent physical coordinates; upstream repeat padding for fewer candidates.
cellect.decoder: Released between-frame ranking, distance and division gates, with deterministic unique incoming links on ties. Cellpose instances replace native intraframe grouping. No coordinate-based track reconnection; it is not applicable to fixed external IDs. All input observations retained.
cellect.last_frame: Duplicate frame 99 as context to preserve all 100 frames; upstream CLI otherwise stops early.

controls: Report a separate no-division graph for each family. No parameter search on the evaluation labels.
runtime: Named existing environments, CPU preprocessing, short shared GPU leases, float32 with TF32/autocast disabled.
evaluation: Freeze complete graphs before official scoring, round-trip CSV check, report both embryos and sparse-label error attribution.
exposure: No Biohub fitting in these experiments. External checkpoint training exposure must be described from available provenance; this is not new-embryo validation.
